name: com.kobapps.gametestkit
description: AAA-grade end-to-end game testing framework for Unity. Drives real gameplay with real simulated user input (click, tap, drag, swipe, keys, gamepad) at the device level, addresses game objects with a Playwright-style locator language with implicit waiting, runs declarative .gametest.json scripts or a C# fluent API, batches suites from the Editor, the CLI or a built player, records tests from live play, and exposes a first-class AI interface so agents can discover, author, run and debug tests on their own.

samples.description: A tiny playable scene (menu, shop, drag-and-drop board) with .gametest.json scripts covering every step type.
Drop-in test assembly that exposes every .gametest.json script as a PlayMode NUnit test, so `-runTests` and the Test Runner window pick them up.
